description: The bar chart illustrates the bias percentage in responses before and after instruction tuning across three categories: Sports, Community, and Healthcare. The vertical axis represents the bias percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the three categories. Each category has four bars representing 'No Contact Before', 'Positive Contact Before', 'Negative Contact Before', and 'No Contact After'. The 'No Contact Before' bars are lighter shaded, indicating the initial bias percentage, while the 'No Contact After' bars are darker shaded, showing the bias percentage after instruction tuning. In the Sports category, the bias percentage decreases from 7.45% before instruction tuning to 0.11% after. In the Community category, the bias percentage drops from 38.08% before to 0.00% after. In the Healthcare category, the bias percentage reduces from 40.79% before to 0.01% after. The chart suggests that instruction-tuning effectively reduces biases to nearly zero across all categories.
